item.title: RUMOR: Here's When The First Full AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Trailer Will Be Released
item.description: Three Avengers: Doomsday teasers have found their way into theaters this month, but when will the first full trailer for the movie be released? A new rumour reveals the expected launch date.

item.title: BLACK PANTHER Director Ryan Coogler Reveals That Sony Blocked Him From Using Kraven The Hunter
item.description: Black Panther director Ryan Coogler has revealed that Sony Pictures blocked him from using Kraven the Hunter in the 2018 movie and debunks a long-standing rumour about who was set to play the character.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumored To Feature Two Incredible Fights Fans Have Dreamed Of Seeing On Screen - SPOILERS
item.description: Avengers: Doomsday is going to feature all manner of dream team-ups, and a new rumour suggests we can expect to see two mind-blowing clashes on the big screen next December.

item.title: LOKI Star Tom Hiddleston Teases AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY's "Monumental," "Surprising" Story
item.description: Hyping up his return in next December's Avengers: Doomsday, Loki actor Tom Hiddleston has promised fans that the movie boasts a "monumental" story that "has never been done before."

item.title: BLACK PANTHER Director Ryan Coogler Reveals Original Plans For Chadwick Boseman's T'Challa In WAKANDA FOREVER
item.description: Black Panther director Ryan Coogler has revealed his amazing, unfortunately scrapped, plans for the version of the sequel that was set to be headlined by the late Chadwick Boseman.

item.title: RUMOR: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY's Plans For Doctor Doom Completely Changes THE FANTASTIC FOUR's Post-Credits Scene
item.description: A new Avengers: Doomsday rumour sheds light on the Russo Brothers' unique plans for Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom, and how the villain factors into the movie's story.

item.title: ABSOLUTE BATMAN Reveals A Twisted First Look At The Redesigned Absolute Poison Ivy
item.description: February's Absolute Batman will finally introduce the Absolute version of Poison Ivy, but is her redesign as drastic as what we've seen from characters like Bane and The Joker?

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Fan Art Gives James Marsden's Cyclops The Respect He Deserves Following Leaked Trailer
item.description: Following the latest leaked teaser for Avengers: Doomsday, newly revealed fan art inspired by the trailer gives James Marsden's Scott Summers/Cyclops the respect he deserves.

item.title: BLACK PANTHER 3: Ryan Coogler Explains Why He's Making The Threequel And Writing For Denzel Washington
item.description: Black Panther 3 director Ryan Coogler has revealed what's brought him back to the MCU for the upcoming threequel and comments on Denzel Washington's mystery role.

item.title: THE LAST OF US Season 3 Is Recasting AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Star Danny Ramirez's Role
item.description: With Danny Ramirez's role in the MCU as The Falcon expanding ahead of Avengers: Doomsday's release, it's been revealed that his character in The Last of Us will be recast for Season 3.
